programme.title: أم رتيبة
programme.desc: فيلم عربي من بطولة ماري منيب وحسن فايق. العمل من إخراج السيد بدير، عام 1959.

programme.title: على باب الوزير
programme.desc: كمال شاب تربطه علاقة حب بريئة بالطالبة الجامعية نورا، لكن والدها الجزار يرفض زواجهما بسبب فقر كمال ووالده (عبدالصمد) مقارنة بما يملك هو من ثروة. لهذا يقوم بتلفيق قضية رشوة للرجل الطيب والد كمال فيودع بالسجن. أما (أنهار) الجارة فقد خدعها خميس وشوّه سمعتها وهرب، وتركها لمصيرها وفضيحتها!

programme.title: طباخ الريس
programme.desc: متولي يعمل طباخاً شعبياً في أزقة القاهرة. تضحك له الدنيا حين يلتقي برئيس الجمهورية ويرشح للعمل في قصره. يحبه الرئيس ويعتبره مرآة الشعب الذي ينقل له الأخبار الصادقة وما يشاع عنه من أخبار وآخر النكات. لم يرق الأمر للوزراء والحاشية الفاسدة، فماذا هم فاعلون؟ تابعوه واضحكوا من القلب!

programme.title: اللمبي 8 جيجا
programme.desc: فيلم كوميدي خيالي تدور أحداثه حول طالب بكلية الحقوق يرسب أكثر من مرة لكنه يتخرج في نهاية المطاف. يتعرض اللمبي لحادث مفاجئ يفقده الذاكرة. أحد الأطباء بالجراحة الكترونية يخترع وسيلة يتحول من خلالها اللمبي إلى محام عبقري، تقلب حياته من فشل ذريع إلى إلى نجاح باهر! احرصوا ألا يفوتكم لتضحكوا كثيراً!

programme.title: أم رتيبة
programme.desc: فيلم عربي من بطولة ماري منيب وحسن فايق. العمل من إخراج السيد بدير، عام 1959.

programme.title: على باب الوزير
programme.desc: كمال شاب تربطه علاقة حب بريئة بالطالبة الجامعية نورا، لكن والدها الجزار يرفض زواجهما بسبب فقر كمال ووالده (عبدالصمد) مقارنة بما يملك هو من ثروة. لهذا يقوم بتلفيق قضية رشوة للرجل الطيب والد كمال فيودع بالسجن. أما (أنهار) الجارة فقد خدعها خميس وشوّه سمعتها وهرب، وتركها لمصيرها وفضيحتها!

programme.title: طباخ الريس
programme.desc: متولي يعمل طباخاً شعبياً في أزقة القاهرة. تضحك له الدنيا حين يلتقي برئيس الجمهورية ويرشح للعمل في قصره. يحبه الرئيس ويعتبره مرآة الشعب الذي ينقل له الأخبار الصادقة وما يشاع عنه من أخبار وآخر النكات. لم يرق الأمر للوزراء والحاشية الفاسدة، فماذا هم فاعلون؟ تابعوه واضحكوا من القلب!

programme.title: سعادة المجنون:الحلقة 30
programme.desc: في لعبة شطرنج بشرية يقودها الجنون والطمع، يجد "أوس صبري" نفسه مضطراً للاعتراف بجريمة قتل لم يرتكبها، فيتواطأ مع شقيقه ووزير العدل ليُرسل لمصح عقلي، ليخرج وينفذ خطة انتقامه ممن ظلمه.

programme.title: لعبة السعادة:الحلقة 29
programme.desc: يعثر مسعود ومسعد على خريطة سحرية تقودهما نحو كنزٍ عظيم، لكن نبوءة غامضة تجعل السباق بينهما، إذ لا يستطيع كشف سر الخريطة والوصول إلى الكنز المنشود سوى شخص واحد فقط.

programme.title: على قد الحب:الحلقة 15
programme.desc: دراما نفسية مشوّقة عن مريم، مصممة المجوهرات، والشيف كريم، وهما يواجهان صراعات عاطفية عميقة، ورغبات هشّة، والثمن الحقيقي للحب والبقاء.

programme.title: جوما:الحلقة 15
programme.desc: دراما نفسية مشوقة تتابع قصة كارمن التي تعاني من فقدان جزئي للذاكرة، وطبيب نفسي تتقاطع حياته مع أشخاص تُشوّه - أسرار خفية - علاقاتهم الشخصية والمهنية، ما يخلق صراعاً وألماً لجميع الأطراف.

programme.desc: تتغير حياة يارا بالكامل عندما تحصل على منحة دراسية في أرقى مدارس البلاد، لتدخل عالمًا جديدًا مليئًا بالتحديات، حيث تتحوّل كل عقبة أمامها إلى فرصة لإثبات نفسها وصنع نجاح استثنائي.

programme.title: على قد الحب:الحلقة 19
programme.desc: دراما نفسية مشوّقة عن مريم، مصممة المجوهرات، والشيف كريم، وهما يواجهان صراعات عاطفية عميقة، ورغبات هشّة، والثمن الحقيقي للحب والبقاء.

programme.title: Alerta Cobra
programme.desc: Una superproducción internacional de Bollywood se rueda en plena autopista cuando Semir y Paul irrumpen en el set con su coche patrulla. Pero la situación da un giro dramático cuando la estrella india Priya Shetty es secuestrada. Los criminales exigen medio millón de euros al productor y prometido de la actriz, Anupam Khan. Comienza entonces una frenética búsqueda para encontrarla. Como si no tuvieran suficiente trabajo, los agentes también deben soportar las constantes interferencias del insoportable actor Abishek Roshan. Cuando localizan el escondite de los secuestradores, descubren que el rescate ya se ha entregado. Todo desemboca en un tiroteo, una explosión y un devastador incendio en el que aparentemente muere Priya. Consumido por la culpa, Paul sigue investigando y pronto encuentra pistas que demuestran que nada es lo que parece.

programme.title: Lo que la verdad esconde: El caso Asunta
programme.desc: La producción recopila datos, plantea preguntas y nuevas perspectivas sobre los acontecimientos, la investigación y el juicio a los padres de Asunta Basterra, la niña gallega asesinada en Santiago de Compostela. Junto a un pequeño equipo de producción, la investigadora Ana Sanmartín y un equipo de rodaje curtido en el mundo del cine, trabajan durante más de un año para intentar dar con las claves de lo sucedido aquel 21 de septiembre de 2013. Para ello, contactan y/o entrevistan a más de 100 personas entre los que se incluyen a investigadores, jueces, abogados, testigos y familiares.

By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Military-industrial thugs kill a Marine (Daniel Hugh Kelly) to keep him quiet, but his ex-Marine wife (Amy Madigan) fights back.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Military-industrial thugs kill a Marine (Daniel Hugh Kelly) to keep him quiet, but his ex-Marine wife (Amy Madigan) fights back.

programme.title: After Dark, My Sweet
programme.desc: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts.

programme.title: The Blood of Heroes
programme.desc: Another woman joins a future gladiator's band of "juggers" against fighters of the ruling elite.

programme.title: Lulu on the Bridge
programme.desc: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino).

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead

programme.title: American Heart
programme.desc: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). programme.title: Any Last Words?
programme.desc: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Call of the Jungle
programme.desc: Trouble comes to a tropical island paradise when sacred pearls are stolen from a tribal temple. Local amateur sleuth Tana (Ann Corio) decides to investigate the matter to find out who's responsible, but following leads only earns her a place on the authorities' list of suspects. Meanwhile, a police officer, Jim (James Bush), is injured while working on the case, and Tana, nursing him back to health, attempts to get him to team up with her to track down the real crooks.

programme.title: The Emerald Forest
programme.desc: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

rating.system: Instituto Nacional de Cine y Artes Audiovisuales

programme.title: Solomon and Sheba
programme.desc: Near death, King David has a vision that his poet son, Solomon (Yul Brynner), should succeed him, rather than hot-headed Adonijah (George Sanders). Furious, Adonijah departs the court, swearing he will become king. Other rulers are concerned that Solomon's benevolent rule and interest in monotheism will threaten their tyrannical, polytheistic kingdoms. The Queen of Sheba (Gina Lollobrigida) makes an agreement with the Egyptian pharaoh (David Farrar) to corrupt Solomon for their mutual benefit.

programme.title: The Satan Bug
programme.desc: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction.

programme.title: Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Based on Jack London's classic about two gold-seekers who forge their way to the Klondike with their faithful dog Buck.

programme.title: True Heart
programme.desc: Twin brother and sister Sam and Bonnie, who argue frequently, become stranded after surviving a horrific plane crash in the Canadian wilderness. While struggling through the forest, they meet a wily Native North American named Khonanesta, who agrees to help them reunite with their family. As the trio traverses the treacherous wood, they strive to elude poachers who wish to hunt Khonanesta's adored Kodiak bear companion.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Flight From Ashiya
programme.desc: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

programme.title: Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert.

programme.title: The Comedy of Terrors
programme.desc: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. Desperate for money after a widow stiffs him for a burial, Trumbull and his assistant, Gillie (Peter Lorre), decide to kill the wealthy Mr. Black (Basil Rathbone), their landlord, to whom they're indebted. But murdering Black proves to be quite a challenge, as he seems to keep recovering from death every time they do him in.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

programme.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
programme.desc: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype.

Elizabeth bears John's son and eventually marries her kindly boss. Unknown to her, John has survived but is horribly disfigured and remains in Europe. Years later, on the eve of World War II, Elizabeth refuses to agree to her son's request to enlist and is stunned when an eerily familiar stranger named Kessler arrives from abroad and becomes involved.

programme.desc: In this musical, college classmates Todd Armstrong (Frankie Avalon) and Craig Gamble (Dwayne Hickman) head out on a group ski vacation, and agree that if they're going to get girlfriends, they need to understand how women think. So when they arrive at the ski lodge, Todd and Craig dress up as young women and pal around with female classmates. Though this provides a bit of insight, the plan goes awry when a male classmate falls for the female version of Craig and pursues him all over the resort.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Sergeant Deadhead
programme.desc: After setting off a rocket during a parade, Sergeant Deadhead (Frankie Avalon) is sent to a guardhouse by his commanding officer, General Fogg (Fred Clark). While attempting to escape, Deadhead accidentally boards a rocket and launches himself into space with a chimpanzee. Deadhead and the chimpanzee are eventually recovered by the air force, but upon his return to Earth, it becomes clear that Deadhead has undergone an unbelievable personality change.

programme.title: De Sade
programme.desc: The 18th-century French marquis (Keir Dullea) recalls his sadomasochistic experiments and goes to jail for lewd behavior.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: For Those Who Think Young
programme.desc: Youth is in full swing at Oceancrest College, and no place swings harder than the Silver Palms, the choice hot spot for student Sandy (Pamela Tiffin) and her pals. Sandy's uncle, Woody (Woody Woodbury), who performs a comedy act at the club, has his livelihood threatened when wealthy conservative Edgar Cronin (Robert Middleton) attempts to shutter the wild hangout for good. This makes things especially sticky for Cronin's grandson, Ding (James Darren), who's trying to get a date with Sandy.

programme.title: Just for Kicks
programme.desc: A stranger tries to help twin brothers (Cole Sprouse, Dylan Sprouse) who play for a winless soccer team.

programme.title: Ski Party
programme.desc: In this musical, college classmates Todd Armstrong (Frankie Avalon) and Craig Gamble (Dwayne Hickman) head out on a group ski vacation, and agree that if they're going to get girlfriends, they need to understand how women think. So when they arrive at the ski lodge, Todd and Craig dress up as young women and pal around with female classmates. Though this provides a bit of insight, the plan goes awry when a male classmate falls for the female version of Craig and pursues him all over the resort.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. While attempting to escape, Deadhead accidentally boards a rocket and launches himself into space with a chimpanzee. Deadhead and the chimpanzee are eventually recovered by the air force, but upon his return to Earth, it becomes clear that Deadhead has undergone an unbelievable personality change.

programme.title: Heart of a Child
programme.desc: An Austrian boy's (Richard Williams) cruel father (Donald Pleasence) plans to sell his Saint Bernard to a butcher.

programme.title: He Who Must Die
programme.desc: Three townspeople cause an uproar when they try to help refugees on a Greek island occupied by Turks.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

rating.system: Instituto de Cinematografía y de las Artes Visuales

programme.title: Extremities
programme.desc: Marjorie (Farrah Fawcett) manages to fight off a rapist and flee to safety. Because her attacker got away and Marjorie has no proof of the crime, police officers tell her there is little they can do. Because Marjorie's attacker also stole her purse, she fears that he will use its contents to track her down. When Joe (James Russo) does show up at Marjorie's house to finish what he started, he discovers that Marjorie is not the fragile victim he imagined.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: A Cold Wind in August
programme.desc: A 28-year-old stripper (Lola Albright) on vacation seduces the 17-year-old son (Scott Marlowe) of her New York building's superintendent.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: The Children of Times Square
programme.desc: The mother (Joanna Cassidy) of a runaway (Brandon Douglas) tries to save him from a cocaine dealer's (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) youth gang in New York.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
programme.desc: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Tomahawk Trail
programme.desc: Cavalry veteran Sgt. Wade McCoy immediately butts heads with his new supervisor, Lt. Jonathan Davenport, over the latter's lack of experience on the treacherous route known as the "Tomahawk Trail," but Davenport's unfamiliarity with the territory proves deadly when a trip to Fort Bowie finds the troop under Apache attack. Crazy from the heat, Davenport turns on his men, forcing McCoy to go against his commanding officer in order to save the lives of others.

programme.title: Winterhawk
programme.desc: A Montana trapper (Leif Erickson) leads the search for a boy and a girl kidnapped by a noble Indian chief (Michael Dante).

programme.title: Adiós, Sabata
programme.desc: Gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) allies himself with a group of wily Mexican revolutionaries scheming to overthrow Emperor Maximilian and expel the occupying Austrians from their homeland. Part of their plan involves stealing a shipment of gold and using it to purchase artillery. It won't be easy, however, as the gold is under the protection of the corrupt and sadistic Col. Skimmel (Gerard Herter). As Sabata pulls off the daring heist, he must take on dozens of enraged Austrian forces.

programme.title: The Return of Sabata
programme.desc: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit.

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge
programme.desc: Under the eye of timid Capt. George (Lloyd Bridges), a group of Cheyenne Native Americans are on a forced march from their homelands to a reservation. When builders strike gold on their new settlement, the Cheyenne are diverted to make way for greedy prospectors. Tate (Rory Calhoun), who is secretly in love with Pretty Willow, is sent to scout a new location for the Cheyenne. Tensions quickly arise between the cavalry and the vengeful Chief Little Wolf (Vince Edwards).

programme.title: The Iroquois Trail
programme.desc: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.title: Geronimo
programme.desc: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. Geronimo is befriended by a schoolteacher (Kamala Devi), who tries to broaden his horizons, but corruption on the reservation forces him to take his band and head for the mountains, where the Apaches wage a doomed war against the white man.

programme.title: War Paint
programme.desc: With only nine days to deliver a peace treaty to the chief of a strong Native American tribe, Lt. programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli).

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Sonora Stagecoach
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele, Chief Thundercloud) escort an innocent man to a fair trial.

programme.title: Gun Belt
programme.desc: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). But when Matt tricks him into participating in a bank robbery -- and frames him as the ringleader -- Billy is forced to go on the run from lawman Wyatt Earp (James Millican), and once again take up his guns against his former rival, Ike Clinton (William Bishop).

programme.desc: In order to trap an outlaw gang, the Epitaph reports that a gang member is turning state's witness; the outlaw dies of his wounds, but his death is kept secret; in a bold move, the gang kidnaps Claiborne and offers to exchange him for the outlaw.

programme.title: The Iron Sheriff
programme.desc: When his son Benjie is accused of killing a stagecoach driver, Sheriff Sam Galt is convinced his boy is innocent. On a quest to clear his son's name, Galt spares no expense in hiring lawyers. While Galt's position as town sheriff raises suspicions of police misconduct, he makes it clear he won't stand in the way of the law. But that certainty is thrown into doubt when Galt goes on a search for the real murderer -- and makes a startling discovery.

programme.title: The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: An 11-year-old Quaker boy sets out across the grasslands of 1880s Montana to avenge his family's deaths.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalphunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

programme.title: Vestiaires

programme.desc: Notre corps a besoin d'une variété de mouvements pour assurer sa vitalité et pour minimiser les risques de blessures ; on propose des mouvements alternatifs ou complémentaires à la posture assise pour maintenir la santé des articulations.

programme.title: Pas de panique, on cuisine!
programme.sub-title: Chili végétarien et brownies aux haricots blancs
programme.desc: Les deux chefs concoctent un chili comme plat principal et proposent des brownies aux haricots blancs en guise de dessert ; Véronique met Bob au défi d'identifier les boîtes de conserve les yeux bandés.

programme.title: Tous en choeur
programme.desc: Une Marche avec Anne-Élisabeth Bossé, une sortie à la cabane à sucre et un concert final réunissant les quatre choeurs. Les choristes montent sur scène, fiers du chemin parcouru et tournés vers l'avenir.

programme.title: Divergentes
programme.desc: Comment élever un enfant quand on peine déjà à s'occuper de soi ; Coco et Naadei abordent les défis de la maternité ; Kim Rusk ouvre les portes de son quotidien de maman ; Coco rencontre Lucilla, mère d'un garçon autiste et elle-même sur le spectre.

programme.title: Et si c'était toi?
programme.desc: Jeune retraitée, la pétillante Élodie, 41 ans, cherche une relation sérieuse; lors de ses trois rendez-vous, elle se promène dans un champ avec Geneviève, s'adonne à une activité nautique avec Nancy, et grille des guimauves au bord du feu avec Sarah.

programme.title: Ça me regarde
programme.desc: Un magazine de service qui place le handicap au cœur des préoccupations et est un lieu de rassemblement pour celles et ceux qui vivent avec des limitations fonctionnelles ou qui sont proches de cette réalité.

programme.title: Ça ne se demande pas
programme.desc: Des personnes qui vivent avec un trouble bipolaire ont accepté de faire face à la caméra et de répondre aux questions du public ; elles n'ont pas honte de vivre avec leur condition ; elles se dévoilent avec émotion.

programme.title: Voir la musique autrement
programme.desc: Le pianiste espagnol Raúl Thaïs Antequera cherche une musique libre de contraintes pendant que le multi-instrumentiste Tcha Limberger, un Rom de Belgique établi en Espagne, a parcouru la planète pour apprendre les différents styles musicaux.

programme.title: Je suis moi, l'artiste!
programme.desc: L'école Les Muses offre une formation professionnelle en théâtre, en chant, en danse et en jeu devant la caméra à de jeunes artistes vivant avec une déficience intellectuelle, un trouble du spectre de l'autisme et des limitations physiques.

programme.title: Une lueur au bout du tunnel
programme.desc: On découvre le quotidien bouleversé de Jade, Fanny, Marie et Christine, quatre femmes résilientes aux prises avec le syndrome d'Usher, une maladie méconnue s'attaquant d'abord à l'ouïe puis au champ visuel.

programme.title: Viens souper
programme.desc: Le handicap peut affecter les capacités physiques ou cognitives, mais n'empêche pas forcément une vie sexuelle épanouie ; Dominic accueille, le temps d'un souper, trois personnes pour qui il est primordial de fréquenter le septième ciel.

programme.title: Beyond the Gates
programme.desc: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life -- and some with more grace than others.

At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. programme.desc: Night Is Not Eternal is a deeply personal exploration of political activism through the eyes of Chinese American filmmaker Nanfu Wang. For over seven years, Nanfu follows Rosa Maria Paya, a young Cuban activist and daughter of five-time Nobel Peace Prize nominee Oswaldo Paya, in her fight for democratic change in Cuba. Driven by her own experiences in China, Nanfu is drawn to Rosa's story and the parallels between their homelands. With intimate access, Nanfu follows Rosa's journey from the streets of Havana to rallies and conferences worldwide, capturing her transformation from a grassroots activist to an international public figure and documenting the challenges faced by activists resisting authoritarian regimes.

programme.title: La fièvre des encans: nouvelle génération
programme.desc: Bob surprend toute l'équipe en découvrant une pièce passée complètement sous le radar de ses deux acolytes friands d'antiquités ; Karine et Dominic sont sous le choc.

programme.title: Les rois de la récup
programme.desc: Ted, Brandon et Rochelle se rendent à Belleville dans le but de voir si une vieille ferme et une ancienne usine à chapeaux peuvent être récupérées; dans le grenier, Ted met la main sur deux mystérieux portraits datant de 200 ans.

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Kidd et Harry traversent des eaux vives intenses pour atteindre les frayères des truites arc-en-ciel. Eustace fabrique des poutres massives pour réparer un quai en mauvais état dans une marina locale. Aron et Jen scient leur propre bois et reconstruisent le toit d'une cabane.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Jake et ses chiens abattent trois chats en une seule journée; Paul prépare son chargement de fourrure d'hiver pour le marché et explore une nouvelle parcelle de terre qui lui appartiendra; Eustace construit un ascenseur à bateaux en utilisant des troncs d'arbres massifs et une poulie à palan; Aron s'efforce de rétablir l'eau courante sur sa propriété, tandis que Jen prépare la serre pour la saison des cultures; Ray soumet son chien à une série d'exercices de recherche et de sauvetage.

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire

programme.title: La vie après nous
programme.desc: À la disparition de l'humanité, la machine commerciale mondiale en viendrait à connaître un grand effondrement : des centres commerciaux délabrés, des voies maritimes dangereuses et des épiceries métamorphosées en champs de bataille pour rongeurs et prédateurs de toutes sortes. programme.title: Première affaire
programme.desc: Jeune avocate fraîchement diplômée, Nora, 26 ans, a l'impression de n'avoir aucune expérience de la vie lorsqu'elle se retrouve plongée dans sa première affaire de droit pénal. Dès sa première rencontre avec son client en garde à vue et tout au long de l'enquête, Nora découvre la cruauté du monde qui entoure sa vie privée et professionnelle. Rapidement emportée par la frénésie de sa nouvelle vie, elle commet erreur sur erreur, ce qui l'amène à s'interroger sur ses choix de vie.

programme.title: La syndicaliste
programme.desc: En 2012, Maureen Kearney, déléguée CFDT chez Areva, est devenue lanceuse d'alerte pour dénoncer un secret d'État qui a secoué l'industrie du nucléaire en France. Seule contre tous, elle s'est battue bec et ongles contre les ministres et les industriels pour faire éclater ce scandale et défendre plus de 50 000 emplois jusqu'au jour où elle s'est fait violemment agresser et a vu sa vie basculer.

programme.title: Le salaire de la peur
programme.desc: À Las Piedras, sorte de ville frontière à la population hybride, le travail manque. Chacun noie, sous le soleil, son ennui dans l'alcool. Non loin de la ville, le SOC, une compagnie pétrolière américaine, fait la pluie et le beau temps des embauches. Un jour, elle réclame quatre volontaires pour conduire deux camions chargés de nitroglycérine afin de souffler l'incendie d'un puits situé à cinq cents kilomètres.

programme.desc: Dans le coeur du Morvan, le dernier vétérinaire du coin, Nico, met les bouchées doubles afin de sauver ses patients, sa clinique ainsi que sa famille. Lorsque son associé et mentor Michel lui annonce sa décision de prendre sa retraite, Nico sait que la passe la plus difficile est imminente. Or, la relève trouvée par Michel, Alexandra, est fraîchement diplômée et ne semble pas d'avis à rester dans son village d'enfance. On se demande donc si Nico réussira à la convaincre de rester.

programme.title: Euroliga
programme.desc: La máxima competición continental de baloncesto reincide en su formato consolidado de 20 equipos y una intensa fase regular de 38 jornadas. Una exigente competición que cuenta con Valencia Basket, Real Madrid, Barcelona y Baskonia como representantes españoles. Olympiacos defiende título.

programme.title: Los secretos de La Roja: campeones del mundo
programme.desc: El 11 de julio de 2010 quedará para siempre como una de las fechas más importantes del fútbol español. Ese día, la selección española consiguió su ansiada primera Copa del Mundo. Este documental narra el camino hacia la victoria de la Roja.

programme.title: International Friendly Match
programme.desc: Las selecciones completan su calendario internacional con la disputa de amistosos. Los técnicos aprovechan estas citas para perfilar detalles en sus equipos nacionales.

programme.title: Premier Pádel - Dubái
programme.desc: Tras la intensidad del Mundial de pádel, las parejas habituales vuelven a reunirse para la disputa del P1 de Dubái. El Hamdan Sports Complex acoge la cita hasta el 15 de noviembre. En juego, una bolsa de casi 500.000 euros.

programme.title: Andrés Iniesta, El Héroe Inesperado
programme.desc: Una mirada íntima a la vida y carrera de Andrés Iniesta, abarcando el inicio de su trayectoria en La Masía, la academia juvenil del FC Barcelona, hasta su ascenso meteórico a la fama jugando para el Barça y la Selección Española, donde sus habilidades en el campo llevaron al conjunto nacional a llevarse el Mundial en 2010, y su llegada al Vissel Kobe en Japón. Junto al testimonio del propio Iniesta, el documental le rinde homenaje con entrevistas a jugadores de renombre mundial como Lionel Messi, Neymar, Luis Suárez, Pep Guardiola o Xavi Hernández. El documental está escrito por el periodista Marcos López, quien ha seguido de cerca la carrera de Iniesta y escribió su biografía oficial.

programme.title: Vamos al Frontón
programme.desc: El cuatro y medio llega a su momento culminante con la gran final de la jaula de Serie B. En Irún, localidad natal del zurdo Amiano y finalista en 2025, se mide a un pelotari experto como Iraitz Zubizarreta.

programme.title: Circuito Nacional de Turf
programme.desc: Las mejores carreras de caballos del Circuito Profesional donde están presentes los mejores jinetes y caballos de nuestro país desde los hipódromos más prestigiosos y famosos.

programme.title: Antoine Griezmann. Enamorado del Atleti
programme.desc: Vivimos junto a Antoine Griezmann el día que se despide ante su afición. Un documental íntimo que repasa sus sensaciones y reflexiones tras convertirse en una de las leyendas del club.

programme.title: Soy Carl Lewis
programme.desc: El documental explora la vida del legendario nueve veces campeón olímpico. Revela su lucha por profesionalizar el atletismo y exigir un pago justo para los atletas, transformando un deporte 'amateur' en un negocio millonario.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Escocia y Nueva Zelanda se miden en el estadio de Murrayfield, Edimburgo, en la cuarta jornada del Nations Championship, nuevo torneo bianual que reúne a los 12 mejores equipos del mundo y coronará al rey de los hemisferios.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: Torneo Apertura Mercado Libre
programme.desc: El Torneo Clausura cierra la Primera División argentina. Se trata de una competición independiente del Apertura, con su propia clasificación, playoffs y campeón, aunque los puntos de ambas fases regulares determinan los puestos continentales y los descensos.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Francia y Sudáfrica, campeona del 6 Naciones y campeona del mundo, respectivamente, se miden en un partido colosal por la 5ª jornada del Nations Championship 2026.

programme.title: Informe Plus+
programme.desc: Dominó el ciclismo mundial y el Tour de Francia durante cinco años consecutivos. Mucho se ha hablado de la historia de éxito de Miguel Indurain, pero, ¿cómo era enfrentarse a él desde dentro? Nos acercamos a la figura del navarro a través de aquellos que le padecieron. El miedo a Miguel marcó la carrera de otros grandes ciclistas como Bugno, Chiappucci, Rominger, Ugrumov o Zülle. Sus grandes rivales recuerdan una época en la que ser segundo ya era una hazaña.

programme.title: Raúl, pase sin llamar
programme.desc: El 29 de octubre de 1994 Raúl Gonzalez Blanco debutaba en La Romareda con el Real Madrid a los 17 años. Con el tiempo se convertiría en una leyenda. Los técnicos que hicieron posible ese milagro, sus compañeros y los testigos directos de aquel momento histórico lo recuerdan en este documental.

programme.title: Soy leyenda
programme.desc: Seguimos los pasos de un delantero único, goleador en dos finales de Champions. Amigos y excompañeros recuerdan algunos de los momentos vividos junto a Samuel Eto'o en sus distintos equipos en el fútbol español.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: Soy leyenda
programme.desc: Mucho se ha comentado sobre la filosofía del entrenador del Atlético de Madrid. En este capítulo viajamos a la etapa del Simeone jugador, así como sus primeros años en los banquillos para buscar las bases de las que bebe el 'cholismo'.

programme.title: Villeneuve-Pironi: velocidad y tragedia
programme.desc: La rivalidad y la tragedia unen a los pilotos de Fórmula 1 Gilles Villeneuve y Didier Pironi.

programme.title: Soy Carl Lewis
programme.desc: El documental explora la vida del legendario nueve veces campeón olímpico. Revela su lucha por profesionalizar el atletismo y exigir un pago justo para los atletas, transformando un deporte 'amateur' en un negocio millonario.

programme.title: Una vida en diez fotos
programme.desc: Una mirada más allá de la visión popular sobre la carrera de David Beckham para descubrir una historia más profunda: cómo el futbolista utilizó su imagen para transformarse en una marca global.

programme.title: Chava. El ciclista del pueblo
programme.desc: El Chava llegó desde Ávila al corazón de todos los aficionados al ciclismo. Firmó diez años de logros, conquistó 28 victorias y llegó a convertirse en uno de los clásicos en la Vuelta llegando a subir al pódium en 1998.

programme.title: Informe Plus. La fe de Vicky
programme.desc: La mejor futbolista joven de Europa. Dos veces premio Kopa. A sus 20 años, Vicky López tiene ya un palmarés futbolístico impresionante, con el FC Barcelona y con la selección española.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: Charles Thomas: tiempo muerto
programme.desc: Charles Thomas fue una estrella del Barça de baloncesto en los años 70, pero tras una lesión en un partido contra el Madrid cayó en desgracia y un día desapareció sin dejar rastro. Lo daban por muerto, pero 40 años después una llamada lo cambiaría todo.

programme.title: Morata: no saben quién soy
programme.desc: 2024 fue para Morata una montaña rusa en la que el delantero madrileño estuvo, más que nunca, en el centro de todas las miradas. Como capitán de la selección española levantó la Eurocopa, mientras en su vida privada afrontaba la ruptura con su mujer.

programme.title: Premier Pádel - Dubái
programme.desc: Sigue en Movistar Plus+ la temporada Premier Padel 2026, la competición que reúne a las grandes figuras del pádel mundial en un extenso calendario de torneos repartidos por distintos países.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Atractivo duelo entre Escocia y Australia para cerrar la 5ª jornada del Nations Championship 2026 en el estadio de Murrayfield.

programme.title: El último duelo
programme.desc: En la antesala de su posible u ltimo Mundial, Cristiano Ronaldo y Lionel Messi protagonizan un viaje al origen de la rivalidad que transformo el fu tbol moderno y convirtio a LaLiga en un feno meno global.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: Rexach. Correr es de cobardes
programme.desc: Carles Rexach, exjugador y entrenador del FC Barcelona, es una de las figuras más influyentes del club, pero su historia ha permanecido en la sombra. hasta ahora.

programme.title: Dakar: carrera contra el desierto
programme.desc: Durante décadas, el Rally Dakar ha sido mucho más que una carrera: es la máxima prueba de resistencia, habilidad y pasión en el mundo del motor. Este documental ofrece un acceso sin precedentes al corazón del Dakar 2023, acompañando a sus protagonistas.

programme.title: Informe Plus+
programme.desc: El Mundial de México 86 reunió para España situaciones rocambolescas, partidos históricos y el sueño de una victoria casi impensable. Varios componentes de aquella generación rememoran peripecias, jugadas y anécdotas.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. México cuando Maradona se hizo D10S
programme.desc: La actuación individual más prodigiosa de la historia de los Mundiales de fútbol. Escritores, periodistas y varios componentes de aquella selección dirigida por Carlos Bilardo recuerdan un triunfo que viajó acompañado de críticas constantes.

programme.title: Informe Plus. La fe de Vicky
programme.desc: La mejor futbolista joven de Europa. Dos veces premio Kopa. A sus 20 años, Vicky López tiene ya un palmarés futbolístico impresionante, con el FC Barcelona y con la selección española.

programme.title: Euroliga
programme.desc: La máxima competición continental de baloncesto reincide en su formato consolidado de 20 equipos y una intensa fase regular de 38 jornadas. Una exigente competición que cuenta con Valencia Basket, Real Madrid, Barcelona y Baskonia como representantes españoles. Olympiacos defiende título.

programme.title: Los secretos de La Roja: campeones del mundo
programme.desc: El 11 de julio de 2010 quedará para siempre como una de las fechas más importantes del fútbol español. Ese día, la selección española consiguió su ansiada primera Copa del Mundo. Este documental narra el camino hacia la victoria de la Roja.

programme.title: Andrés Iniesta, El Héroe Inesperado
programme.desc: Una mirada íntima a la vida y carrera de Andrés Iniesta, abarcando el inicio de su trayectoria en La Masía, la academia juvenil del FC Barcelona, hasta su ascenso meteórico a la fama jugando para el Barça y la Selección Española, donde sus habilidades en el campo llevaron al conjunto nacional a llevarse el Mundial en 2010, y su llegada al Vissel Kobe en Japón. Junto al testimonio del propio Iniesta, el documental le rinde homenaje con entrevistas a jugadores de renombre mundial como Lionel Messi, Neymar, Luis Suárez, Pep Guardiola o Xavi Hernández. El documental está escrito por el periodista Marcos López, quien ha seguido de cerca la carrera de Iniesta y escribió su biografía oficial.

programme.title: ¡Qué suerte hemos tenido!
programme.desc: Un reportaje especial que, de la mano de las personas que más cerca han estado de Rafa Nadal, echa la vista atrás para recordar la carrera inolvidable de un deportista irrepetible. Los mejores golpes y las victorias épicas del mejor deportista español.

programme.desc: Después de la derrota ante Francia en la final de 98, la selección brasileña fue rechazada como nunca. Cuatro años después, en la Copa del Mundo de 2002, Scolari toma la decisión de competir con un equipo joven, lleno de esperanzas e incertidumbres.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Tras ejecutar su último encargo, Angelo empieza a notar que algo no va bien: su mente comienza a fallar justo cuando las dos vidas que ha mantenido separadas durante años -la de asesino a sueldo y la de padre de familia- empiezan a colisionar.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Después del intento de asesinato contra su hija, Angelo le revela que el hombre responsable de la muerte de su madre ha salido de prisión antes de tiempo. Mientras el FBI lo interroga, Angelo inicia su propia investigación en secreto.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Dutch encarga a Angelo eliminar a un agente de Asuntos Internos que amenaza con desmantelar su organización. Mientras tanto, Maria intenta protegerse tras el ataque sufrido, y la presión aumenta cuando el FBI empieza a sospechar que Angelo oculta algo.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Convencido de que 'El Barquero' está detrás del ataque a su hija, Angelo pospone un encargo para ir tras él. Al mismo tiempo, el FBI avanza en una investigación que empieza a acercarse peligrosamente a su doble vida.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Durante una misión, Angelo revive un momento clave de su pasado: el instante en que descubrió que su hermano padecía Alzheimer, una revelación que le obligó a tomar una decisión que cambiaría su vida para siempre.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Atrapado entre recuerdos fragmentados, Angelo comienza a cuestionar su propia percepción de la realidad. Mientras planea un asesinato de alto riesgo en un escenario público, una investigación policial se acerca cada vez más a descubrir sus secretos.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Angelo descubre que uno de sus trabajos del pasado puede ser clave para desenmascarar a su enemigo. Al mismo tiempo, nuevas pistas amenazan con exponer su doble vida ante quienes más quiere.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Revelaciones inesperadas sacuden los cimientos de la vida de Angelo y ponen en riesgo a su familia. Mientras tanto, Joe recibe una oportunidad que podría cambiar su destino.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Tras un giro impactante, Angelo se lanza en una carrera contrarreloj para proteger a sus seres queridos de la amenaza implacable de 'El Barquero', cuya violencia se intensifica.

programme.title: Memoria de un asesino
programme.desc: Fin de temporada. Las dos vidas de Angelo colisionan definitivamente en un enfrentamiento explosivo con su enemigo. En un final cargado de tensión, todo queda al descubierto en una resolución tan intensa como emocional.

programme.title: One Zoo Three
programme.desc: Hoy en One Zoo Three, las Leyendas del Zoo están de celebración. Hay mucho que preparar para organizar un evento muy especial. Los hermanos están calentando motores para presentar a algunos de los habitantes más longevos.

programme.title: Dulce Navidad
programme.desc: Este documental viaja a Nueva York, Reino Unido y Suecia para visitar tres de las tiendas de caramelos más grandes del mundo durante una de las épocas más especiales del año. Un viaje navideño a través de algunos de los destinos más dulces del planeta.

programme.title: Superagente Hitpig
programme.desc: Hitpig es un cerdo cazarrecompensas que trabaja para una gran corporación capturando fugitivos. Su vida cambia cuando le asignan capturar a Pickles, un simpático elefante que ha escapado de una feria en busca de un lugar donde le quieran.

programme.title: Cruyff
programme.desc: Estrella del fútbol. Genio de los goles imposibles. Fuerza imparable dentro y fuera del campo. Johan Cruyff no fue solo un jugador: fue un visionario que traspasó los límites del deporte. Este es su retrato definitivo.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: Leo talks
programme.desc: Pocas cosas despiertan tanta pasión como la música. Leo recorre sus géneros, rituales y rarezas, desde los casetes y los karaokes hasta los festivales multitudinarios y la inteligencia artificial, encontrando humor en cada compás.

programme.title: Ilustres ignorantes
programme.desc: La actriz Nikki García y el humorista Xavi Puig son los invitados de este capítulo de Ilustres en el que debaten sobre 'Los finales' ¿Qué final les hubiera gustado cambiar en su vida: de una relación, una actuación, una comida.?

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Hace ya muchas generaciones que los Miyagi y los Han están unidos por la amistad y las artes marciales.

programme.title: DeportePlus+ Domingo
programme.desc: Un lugar donde cabe todo el deporte que se juega en el planeta de la mano de Juanma Castaño. La emoción y la pasión con las mejores imágenes, las previas, los resúmenes, los testimonios y el análisis de nuestros expertos.

programme.title: Liga ACB
programme.desc: La Liga Endesa apuesta por el espectáculo. La máxima competición española de clubes cuenta, como es habitual, con una liga regular de 34 jornadas. Los ocho mejores equipos pelean por el título en unos exigentes playoffs. El Valencia Basket defiende corona.

programme.title: Sicarios
programme.desc: Un tiroteo tiene lugar a la salida de una comunión en San Pedro de Alcántara, Marbella. La investigación destapa una peligrosa banda de sicarios asentada en la Costa del Sol. Disparos, explosiones, ajustes de cuentas y mucha violencia.

programme.title: Sicarios
programme.desc: Los sospechosos son profesionales, escurridizos y peligrosos. Las primeras investigaciones llevan el rastro hasta Malmö, Suecia. Las cámaras de seguridad serán claves para seguir avanzando en el caso. ¿Qué relación hay entre Marbella y Malmö?

programme.title: Sicarios
programme.desc: Asesinatos, bombas y mucha violencia. La banda actúa como si nada ni nadie pudiera detenerlos. Cambian constantemente de coche, de casa, de colaboradores y de país, pero la policía española y sueca los tiene cada vez más localizados.

programme.title: John Wick (Otro día para matar)
programme.desc: John Wick es un asesino a sueldo retirado que vuelve a la acción después de que un jefe mafioso haya puesto precio a su cabeza y le haya robado todo lo que le quedaba tras la muerte de su esposa. Además, el sicario contratado para acabar con él es Marcus, un amigo y excompañero suyo que le recomendó que se apartara del mundo criminal. El estadounidense Chad Stahelski se estrenó como director con este filme de acción que resultó ser toda una sorpresa en taquilla cosechando casi 70 millones de euros (teniendo en cuenta que el presupuesto no llegó a los 20 millones). Stahelski, con un largo historial como especialista en películas de acción, volvió a coincidir con Keanu Reeves, al que curiosamente dobló en las escenas más peligrosas de 'Matrix'. Además de Reeves, el elenco de la cinta está repleto de nombres conocidos como los de Alfie Allen (Theon Greyjoy en 'Juego de Tronos'), Willem Defoe ('Platton'), Michael Nyqvist ('Saga Millenium: Los hombres que no amaban a las mujeres'), Ian McShane ('Piratas del Caribe: En mareas misteriosas') y Adrianne Palicki ('Friday Night Lights').
